trigger.error: Period 4 does not divide sequence length 6

affected_shape_cohort.reason: The configured RAFT period 4 divides the context length 96 but not prediction length 6.

recovery_rule.operation: Before RAFT search, retain each configured period, in order, only when it divides both context length and prediction length.

resume_policy.justification: Every completed cell before the failure has prediction length divisible by 4, so filtering retains every configured period and leaves its computation unchanged.
